programmes.d: A love triangle leads to years of stalking, property destruction, threats, and murder.
As detectives investigate a mother of two's sudden disappearance, her friends and family reveal she feared she was being stalked.

A look at the case of con man John Meehan, including interviews with his wife and her daughter, his ex-wife, law enforcement officers, and the Los Angeles Times reporter who shined a spotlight on the story.
Suspicions arise when a man's wife dies in a house fire and then a second tragedy claims his son's life.
A woman finds her way back to her family after being kidnapped 30 years earlier.
A top-ranking officer in the Canadian military pleaded guilty to a number of crimes, from home invasions and lingerie theft to murder.

Convicted murderer Drew Peterson speaks out about the murder of his third wife and the disappearance of his fourth wife in his first network TV interview in more than a decade; insiders close to the case speak out, including Stacy Peterson's sister.

The disappearance of 19-year-old Alaska Native Sonya Ivanoff sends shockwaves through the small coastal city of Nome, Alaska; police scramble to find answers until a note is found in a stolen police vehicle telling the cops to back off or else.
A detective comes face to face with a serial killer when she promises to get justice for the mother of a victim whose body turns up at an Anaheim trash facility.
A woman suspects poisoning when she finds her husband of five months dead on the bedroom floor with no clue as to what happened.
When a small-town Alabama resident is murdered in his home, rumors involving a local pastor begin to swirl as the truth ends up turning the community upside down.
A look at the crimes committed by Charles Manson and his followers in 1969, including archival footage and interviews with those close to the events.
